channel.title: Bloomberg — diagnostic source feed
channel.description: Diagnostic feed grouped by acquisition connector.

item.title: Japan Demands Release of Journalist Arrested in Russian Far East
item.description: Japan’s top government spokesman called for the immediate release of a Japanese journalist detained in Russia for suspected spying, as Moscow denies access to the individual by consular officials.
item.dc:creator: Alastair Gale

item.title: UK to Fly Missions to Defend Saudi Arabia From Houthi Attacks
item.description: UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham asked the Royal Air Force to fly missions to protect Saudi Arabia from Houthi attacks. RAF fighter jets will be deployed to defend Saudi cities and infrastructure against aerial attacks from the Iran-backed Yemeni militant group. Bloomberg's Stuart Livingstone-Wallace and Bloomberg Economics' Ziad Daoud break down the situation. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Citi's English on US Midterm Outlook
item.description: Sahra English, Head of US Government Affairs at Citi, discusses her outlook for US midterm elections. She speaks with Haidi Stroud Watts on the sidelines of the Citi ANZ Investment Conference on "Bloomberg: The Asia Trade". (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Ukraine ‘Wouldn’t Exist’ Without Support From US, Rubio Says
item.description: Secretary of State Marco Rubio defended the Trump administration’s support for Ukraine, saying the nation “would not exist” without US support.
item.dc:creator: Eric Martin

item.title: Meloni Won’t Run With Italy’s Far Right in 2027, Minister Says
item.description: Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni heads into next year’s election with no plans to broaden her coalition to include the new far-right National Future party, said one of the co-founders of her Brothers of Italy party.
item.dc:creator: Chiara Albanese and Donato Paolo Mancini

item.title: Trump PAC Unleashes $277 Million to Aid Republicans in Midterms
item.description: President Donald Trump’s super political action committee unloaded $277 million from the start of September through the first two weeks of October to bolster Republican candidates in midterm election contests, while raking in another $25 million in fundraising.
item.dc:creator: Bill Allison

item.title: Hong Kong Fire Report to Put Government Accountability in Focus
item.description: An independent committee investigating Hong Kong’s deadliest fire in decades will submit its final report to Chief Executive John Lee on Thursday, local media reported, setting up a test of his pledge to pursue accountability.
item.dc:creator: Nectar Gan

item.title: Trump Sued by Democrats Over Effort to Purge State Voter Rolls
item.description: National Democrats sued President Donald Trump and the US Justice Department over what they say is a coordinated effort to erode confidence in the upcoming midterm elections, including by demanding that states like California and Nevada set aside ballots of suspected non-citizens.
item.dc:creator: Erik Larson

item.title: One Year On, Japan’s Takaichi Faces Reality Check on Tax Cut, Defense Promises
item.description: Last October, Sanae Takaichi became the first woman to stand at the lectern of Japan’s parliamentary hall as prime minister. Now, the test is whether she can deliver on her promises.
item.dc:creator: Sakura Murakami and Yoshiaki Nohara

item.title: US-Mexico Trade Talks Hit Impasse as Lutnick Exerts Influence
item.description: US and Mexican trade negotiators have hit an impasse over tariffs on steel and aluminum, dashing earlier optimism for an imminent deal and likely kicking major progress until after the midterm elections, people familiar with the matter said.
item.dc:creator: Alicia Diaz, Eric Martin and Gonzalo Soto

item.title: Griffin Says Republicans Erred by Cutting Taxes Last Year
item.description: Billionaire Ken Griffin said Republicans in Congress and President Donald Trump made a mistake by cutting taxes even further last year.
item.dc:creator: Katherine Burton and Dani Burger

item.title: Brazil Accuses Milei of Election Meddling for Calling Lula ‘Thief’ Ahead of Vote
item.description: Brazil’s government accused Javier Milei of attempting to interfere in its Sunday presidential runoff after the Argentine leader suggested Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva may try to steal the election.
item.dc:creator: Augusta Saraiva

item.title: Ken Griffin on AI, Midterm Elections and Fiscal Policy
item.description: Citadel founder and CEO Ken Griffin discusses the benefits and risks of artificial intelligence. Speaking with Bloomberg's Dani Burger at Citadel's annual Future of Global Markets Conference in New York, Griffin also comments on the midterm elections, the US economy and fiscal policy. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Netflix Growth Slows as Streaming Competition Intensifies
item.description: The Close brings you the latest news and analysis leading up to the final minutes and seconds before and after the closing bell on Wall Street. Today's guests are Cboe Global Markets VP, Head of Derivatives Market Intelligence Mandy Xu, Needham Senior Internet Analyst Laura Martin, PGIM Head of Real Estate Credit Strategies Bryan McDonnell, Gabelli Funds Managing Director for Growth Portfolios John Belton,Gerber Kawasaki Wealth & Investment Management Co-Founder, President, & CEO Ross Gerber, SPG Global Managing Director Simon Gallagher, Former NBCUniversal Head of Seeso Streaming Services Evan Shapiro, Offscript Worldwide CEO Detavio Samuels, & AlixPartners Tech, Media & Telecommunications Americas Leader Jeff Goldstein. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Citadel's Griffin Says US Has to 'Grow the Damn Economy'
item.description: Citadel founder and CEO Ken Griffin says the US has to "grow the damn economy." He says in order to do so, the US has to get Europe to grow its economy. He speaks to Bloomberg's Dani Burger at the Future of Global Markets Conference in New York. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Bloomberg Businessweek Daily Podcast: SpaceX, Netflix Report Earnings
item.description:
The people, companies and trends shaping the global economy. Watch Carol and Tim LIVE every day on YouTube: http://bit.ly/3vTiACF
Netflix reported earnings for the third quarter that exceeded Wall Street expectations, but forecast a fourth consecutive quarter of slowing sales growth. Meanwhile, SpaceX reported revenue for the third quarter that beat the average analyst estimate, sending the companies shares rising in the aftermarket. Elon Musk’s satellite, rocket and artificial intelligence conglomerate posted $4.4 billion in net income for the quarter ended in September, far better than analysts’ average projection of $1.88 billion.
On today's episode:
Ed Ludlow, Co-Host of Bloomberg Tech George Ferguson, Bloomberg Intelligence Global Head of Aerospace, Defense & Airline Analysis Brody Ford, Bloomberg New Tech Reporter Prashant Gopal, Bloomberg News US Real Estate Reporter (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Cboe’s Mandy Xu on Market Volatility
item.description: Mandy Xu, Vice President and Head of Derivatives Market Intelligence at Cboe Global Markets, says options-market sentiment shifted notably over the past week. After positioning had been broadly bullish at both the index and single-stock levels, investors increased hedging demand, particularly for index protection. She speaks with Romaine Bostick & Jess Menton on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Can Japan’s Economy Afford Takaichi’s Gamble?
item.description: A year after taking power, Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi is betting ¥370 trillion ($2.3 trillion) on reviving Japan’s economy. But can she deliver growth without adding to the country’s enormous debt? (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Trump Administration Sued Over 50% Tariffs on Canadian Goods
item.description: The Trump administration is being sued over the imposition of 50% tariffs on an array of Canadian goods, the latest in a string of cases that broadly accuse the president of trying to achieve his trade agenda by asserting a taxing power that belongs to Congress.
item.dc:creator: Zoe Tillman

item.title: Trump Builds Latin America Military Alliance Cheaply
item.description: Donald Trump has slashed US aid to Latin America even as country after country has elected governments aligned with him.
item.dc:creator: Maya Averbuch
